subject: Columbus School Renaming Process and Timeline Extension
overview: The committee established a multi-step voting procedure to narrow down school name nominees and approved a request for a timeline extension from the School Committee. They also formed a subcommittee to draft the final presentation and discussed the recent resignation of a member.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Roll Call
items.summary: The committee conducted a roll call and approved the minutes of the previous meeting.

items.title: Discussion of Member Resignation and Social Media
items.summary: Chair Lister announced the resignation of a committee member following a social media dispute, leading to a discussion regarding the lack of clear social media guidelines for members.

items.title: NAACP Letter Correspondence
items.summary: Chair Lister read a letter from the Mystic Valley NAACP into the record supporting the decision to rename the school and noting other diversity initiatives.

items.title: Methodology for Narrowing Nominee List
items.summary: The committee approved a resolution to pare down the list of 18 nominees using an alphabetical review and a 12-vote threshold for final recommendations. Discussion addressed technical issues preventing some members from accessing the latest rubric and public input data.

items.title: Timeline Extension Request
items.summary: The committee approved a resolution requesting the School Committee delay the final name presentation until after June 4, 2021, to allow more time for deliberation. The motion included a provision that the committee might decline to recommend names if forced to adhere to the original June 7 deadline.

items.title: Presentation Subcommittee Formation
items.summary: Approved the creation of a subcommittee of up to 10 members to draft the final presentation explaining the selection process and recommended names.

items.title: Subcommittee Member Selection and Scheduling
items.summary: Ten members volunteered for the drafting subcommittee, and the body discussed logistical difficulties in scheduling the next full committee meeting due to the upcoming holiday weekend.
